name: Saving
overview: The Scriptures present saving as a wise and deliberate practice, both in the stewardship of resources and the care for others. In the context of saving money, Genesis 41:34 illustrates prudent planning through careful management during times of plenty, while Proverbs 13:11 and 21:20 contrast diligent labor and wise preservation with foolish spending. Proverbs 13:22 highlights the lasting value of leaving an inheritance, and Proverbs 22:7 warns of the bondage of debt, emphasizing financial responsibility. Luke 14:28 further underscores the importance of counting the cost before undertaking significant endeavors. Together, these verses encourage believers to exercise wisdom in saving material resources and to consider the broader implications of stewardship, which also points to the vital importance of saving souls as a spiritual priority.
